note: Build from Deck 0.6: three stages — S1 Read (Deck Reader, runner), S2 Design (Claude live on the canvas), S3 3D (the editor's export). The user approves each in the step bar.

steps.title: S1 Read
steps.hint: upload the .pptx, .pdf or image, pick the floorplan and room, check the crops and the room brief, approve

steps.title: S2 Design
steps.hint: answer each sub-step as Claude draws on the canvas (overlay, walls, objects, materials, lighting), approve

steps.title: S3 3D
steps.hint: export the 3D model (GLB + snapshots), check it, approve
